payingUser: A hobby woodworker or small-shop cabinet maker who needs to turn furniture dimensions into cut-ready material and joint instructions without carrying a laptop into the workshop.
paidUnit: One permanent unlock of unlimited project templates, grain-aware part breakdowns, sheet and board cut-layout optimization, joint/angle solving, sensor bevel checking, and PDF/share export.
momentOfPayment: After a user completes one free small project and previews its cut diagram and export, before exporting another project or enabling the full template library.
distinctnessSentence: Kerfwise takes a finished furniture size through grain-aware parts, stock-aware cut layouts, joint and bevel checks, phone-assisted angle verification, and a shareable cut packet instead of stopping at a cut-list, a generic angle meter, or a gallery of project photos.
day1RevenuePath: A woodworker finds the app from the measured cut-list, woodworking-planner, or miter-angle searches; one complete small-project preview proves the local workflow, and Play Billing collects the permanent unlock at the second export or full-template use.

capabilities.note: INFERRED: a one-time premium workshop workflow uses Billing; ads are deliberately absent because 47% of critical sampled cut-list reviews mentioned ads.

permissions: INFERRED: no runtime permission is required for the accelerometer/gyroscope or SAF document creation; Android 13+ notification permission is requested only if the user enables a local cut-session reminder; Play Billing uses com.android.vending.BILLING. No camera, microphone, location, contacts, Bluetooth, account, or server is required.

archetypesRejected.revenueReason: INFERRED: the optimizer, solver, and export are durable on-device capabilities; selling each project as a new purchase would be artificial rather than a measured consumable.
MEASURED: 7 of 15 critical reviews in the cut-list scan named ads, including a complaint that an ad appeared on every click, so an ads-led version reproduces an observed reason to leave.

MEASURED: six of eight enriched cut-list listings were free with IAP and CutList Optimizer has 1M+ installs, so an upfront listing price would discard the observed free-install funnel without paid-download evidence.
ON RECORD: subscriptions are forbidden by the owner's instruction; this fully local workflow has no recurring service cost that would justify one.

assumptionsUnverified: UNVERIFIED: 147 monthly $9.99 unlocks at a modeled $6.80 net per sale reach $1,000 net; no conversion rate or IAP price from the 1M+ leaders was observed.
INFERRED: $6.80 net assumes a 15% Play fee and a 20% reserve for tax/refund/price-localisation effects; developer fee eligibility and actual refunds were not measured.
UNVERIFIED: the $8.99 paid Miter Angle Calculator at 10+ installs and $2.99 Miter Angle at 1K+ installs establish paid comparators but do not prove a $9.99 multi-feature purchase will convert.
UNVERIFIED: a phone-class device can render sufficiently clear cutting diagrams and run the packing heuristic promptly for real cabinet projects.
